verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine, so GPU acceleration is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never mentions a Vulkan backend or AMD GPU support. The docs stress CPU-only, no-GPU operation, and community reports say the GPU is not used for inference on Apple or Pixel devices.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can accelerate inference on AMD GPUs via a Vulkan backend without needing a full ROCm install
